verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents ships official Python and Node.js frameworks for building realtime agent participants. A hands-on probe confirmed that the pypi livekit-agents 1.8.0 and npm @livekit/agents 1.8.0 packages install and import without a key. The official GitHub repo and testing integrations (pytest/Vitest) back this up. Missing for 10: no SDK API reference or versioning/stability documentation in the evidence, and no evidence of SDKs beyond Python and Node.js.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Agents framework lets you add any Python or Node.js program to LiveKit rooms as full realtime participants.
pypi livekit-agents 1.8.0 installs and `import livekit.agents` succeeds with no key (npm @livekit/agents 1.8.0 also live, ~498k weekly downloads)
Build and deploy a simple voice assistant with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.
